caption: The drawing depicts a front and side view of a tall, rectangular grandfather clock rendered in black ink on a beige or yellowed paper background. The clock features an ornate top with three finials and a decorative broken pediment, along with an arched molding above the face, which is not detailed but indicated by a panel outline. The main body is rectangular with rectangular panels and moldings, and it sit on a plinth base with four shaped feet. Measurements are indicated along the height and sections of the clock, given in inches and fractions of inches, with arrows marking the lines that correspond to the dimensions. The scale is noted as 3/8 inch to 1 foot, written below the side view. The drawing includes the signature "M. Mangiacotti" at the bottom right. There are minor spots of brown discoloration on the paper, and the composition is balanced with the clock occupying the majority of the available space.
title: Clock
